title: Netherlands – Marine survey services – Raamovereenkomst Vooronderzoeken Baggeren Lansingerland
description: Baggerwerkzaamheden maken onderdeel uit van het reguliere beheer en onderhoud van de watergangen binnen de gemeente Lansingerland en vormen daarmee een periodiek terugkerende activiteit. Om de benodigde baggerwerkzaamheden planmatig en doelmatig te kunnen voorbereiden, dient periodiek te worden vastgesteld welke watergangen in aanmerking komen voor uitvoering in de daaropvolgende jaren. De gemeente is voornemens een raamovereenkomst af te sluiten voor het uitvoeren van de benodigde vooronderzoeken en toezicht op baggeren. Deze vooronderzoeken omvatten onder meer het bepalen van het te baggeren areaal, het uitvoeren van waterbodem- en ecologische onderzoeken en overige onderzoeken die noodzakelijk zijn voor de voorbereiding van baggerwerken. De resultaten van deze onderzoeken vormen de basis voor het samenstellen van uitvoerbare werkpakketten voor de reeds gecontracteerde baggeraar. De verwachte omzet voor vier jaar bedraagt € 380.000,-. Het Plafondbedrag van de raamovereenkomst voor vier jaar bedraagt € 494.000,-.

title: Firefox
description: The Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA) has developed a non-invasive coherent optical system capable of recording neural signals in humans. To expand this foundational technology and enable the development of revolutionary, non-invasive brain-computer interfaces (BCIs), DARPA's Firefox program is soliciting approaches to overcome key technological hurdles: 1) development of components enabling dynamic rastering/scanning of the incoming coherent optical signal to target multiple regions of interest and 2) development of new data processing architectures beyond the digital domain to handle the high data rates and computational burden inherent to scaling the amount of neural data recorded by the optical system. The ultimate goal of the Firefox program is to use these innovations to develop a 100-channel, non-invasive BCI with 50-micron spatial and 100-microsecond temporal resolution.

title: Painting and Maintenance Services in Apartments for the U.S. Mission in Paris, France
description: The Embassy of the United States in Paris, France, will release a solicitation for Painting and Maintenance Services in Apartments Leased in Paris and its vicinity by the Embassy of the United States in France. The contractor shall provide all necessary labor, materials, tools, equipment, supervision and any necessary items to perform interior painting, minor plaster/drywall repair, and general make-ready maintenance (electricity, plumbing and carpentry) services between tenant occupancies. The Government estimates servicing approximately 80 to 100 apartments per year. The resulting contract will be an Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contract with a one-year base period and four (4) one-year option periods. The estimated ceiling values for the entire five-year period of performance are between the minimum value of 7,500 Euros ($ 8543) and the not-to-exceed value of 2,925,960 Euros ($ 3,375,000). Please note the solicitation is not ready to be issued as of this date. The Embassy of the United States in Paris, France, will launch the solicitation on the SAM.gov website when it is available. The anticipated release date of the solicitation is October 9, 2026. The Government intends to award the contract resulting from this solicitation to the lowest priced technically acceptable offeror who is a responsible contractor. All contractors have to be registered in the SAM (System for Award Management) Database https://www.sam.gov prior to submitting an offer pursuant to FAR provision 52.204-Therefore, prospective offerors are encouraged to register at the earliest stage. The guidelines for registration in SAM are also available at: https://www.fsd.gov/fsdgov/learning-center-system.do?sysparm_system=SAM This is a pre-solicitation notice only. No proposals or quotes are being requested or accepted at this time.

title: Marine Corps Education Command Information Technology Support Services
description: The Marine Corps Installations Command National Capital Region - Regional Contracting Office (MCINCR-RCO), Quantico, VA, has a requirement for Information Technology Support Services for the United States Marine Corps Education Command (EDCOM). The Government intends to issue a single award Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contract, consisting of Firm Fixed-Price (FFP) Contract Line Items for services and Cost Reimbursement (CR) for travel. The contract will have a five-year ordering period, totaling $45M ceiling value. The proposed acquisition is done as a 100% set aside to Women Owned Small Business. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for this requirement is 541512. The Government is soliciting proposals utilizing commercial contracting under FAR Part 12 and FAR 15- Contracting by Negotiation. The Government intends to award a contract using best value trade-off procedures. The award will be issued on an all or none basis. This procurement is being solicited under solicitation M00264-27-R-0001, which is posted via the Solicitation Module in the Procurement Integration Enterprise Environment (PIEE) website (https://piee.eb.mil). It is the responsibility of the offeror to continually view the website for the solicitation and any amendments. Contractors interested in doing business with the Government must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) website accessed through https://www.sam.gov. Contractor must also ensure annual representations and certifications are current or complete them at the SAM website as well. All prospective offerors interested in submitting an offer must have a commercial and government entity code (CAGE code). The points of contact for this solicitation are Genia Fouts, Contract Specialist at genia.fouts@usmc.mil, Jeffrey A. Sisk Sr. Team Lead at jeffrey.a.sisk@usmc.mil, and Christian Hernandez, Contracting Officer at christian.hernandezsoto@usmc.mil. All responsible sources may submit a proposal for consideration upon solicitation release. NOTE: The pre-solicitation of this requirement was posted in SAM.GOV under related notice RFI M00264-26-RFI-0028. Please note that a new RFP number has been used due to posting in FY2027. The prior referenced RFP no. M00264-26-R-0015 is no longer in use.

title: Solicitation for MSG Cook Services
description: The Permanent Mission ot the United States ot America in Geneva, Switzerland, seeks qualified companies to provide food services. The Contractor shall perform food services work, five days a week from 10:00am to 5:00pm for the U.S. Mission Geneva Marine Security Guards. The MSG detachment at US Mission Geneva consists of nine Marines, which would require one cook to prepare 18 meals per day. The Contractor shall furnish all managerial, administrative, and direct labor personnel that are necessary to accomplish the work in this contract. Contractor employee shall be on site. The anticipated performance period is for a base year with two one-year option periods, if exercised by the Government. All responsible sources may submit a quotation which will be considered. If you would like to submit quotation, follow the instructions in Section 3 of the solicitation, complete the required portions of the attached document, and submit it to the address shown on the Standard Form 1449. Quotations must include: 1. Section 1 Pricing 2. Section 3, Technical Proposal criteria 3. Section 5, Representations and Certifications The U.S. Government intends to award a contract to the responsible company submitting an acceptable offer at the lowest price. We intend to award a contract based on initial quotations, without holding discussions, although we may hold discussions with companies in the competitive range if there is a need to do so. Offerors shall be registered in the SAM (System for Award Management) database at https://www.sam.gov prior to submittal of their offer/proposal as prescribed under FAR 4.1102. Therefore prospective offerers are encouraged to register prior to the submittal of quotations/proposals. This opportunity allows for electronic responses. Quotations are due by November 9th, 2027. No quotations will be accepted after this time.

The Indian Health Service (IHS), Great Plains Area Office, intends to award a single Firm-Fixed-Price, Indefinite-Delivery/Indefinite-Quantity (IDIQ) contract utilizing a Cost-Per-Reportable-Result (CPRR) pricing model for Clinical Laboratory Coagulation Instrumentation analyzers and related supplies and services. The quoted unit pricing must be all inclusive (to include, but not be limited to, travel, lodging, per-diem fringe benefits, federal, state and local taxes) plus all other costs pertinent to the performance of this contract. Absolutely no Gray Market Goods or Counterfeit Electronic Parts shall be provided. Gray Market Goods are defined as genuine, branded goods intentionally or unintentionally sold outside of an authorized sales territory or by nonauthorized dealers in an authorized territory. All equipment shall be accompanied by the Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) warranty. Counterfeit Electronic Parts are defined as unlawful or unauthorized reproduction, substitution, or alteration that has been known. mismarked, misidentified, or otherwise misrepresented to be an authentic, unmodified electronic part from the original manufacturer, or a source with the express written authority of the original manufacturer or current design activity, including an authorized aftermarket manufacturer. Summary: This RFI/SS is issued solely for information and planning purposes and shall not be construed as a solicitation, restrict the Government as to the ultimate acquisition approach, or serve as an obligation on the part of the USAMRDC. In accordance with FAR 15.201(e), responses to this notice are not offers and cannot be accepted by the Government to form a binding contract. Responders are advised that the United States Government will not pay for any information or administrative costs incurred in response to this RFI. The information resulting from this RFI/SS will determine interest and capabilities available in the marketplace; and will assist in developing acquisition strategy. 5. Background: The U.S. Army Medical Research Institute of Infectious Diseases (USAMRIID), located at Fort Detrick, Maryland, is the premier lead medical research laboratory for the U.S. Department of War's biological defense research program. Since 1969, USAMRIID has provided leading edge medical capabilities to deter and defend against current and emerging biological threat agents. The Institute is the only laboratory in the Department of Defense equipped to safely study highly hazardous pathogens requiring maximum containment at Biosafety Level 4. USAMRIID has executed its mission from Building 1425. While historically significant, the legacy facility has surpassed its design lifespan. To sustain the DoD's biosafety integrity and research posture, the Department authorized the design and construction of a state-of-the-art replacement facility: Building 8100. Groundbreaking for the replacement complex took place in August 2009. In 2013, during the final construction execution and fit-out phases, Building 8100 experienced a fire that damaged critical mechanical, electrical, and plumbing infrastructure, Building Automation System controls, and associated laboratory boundary zones. Recovering from this event and achieving facility handover has become an acute operational hardship for the biodefense mission, delaying the transfer of ongoing medical research from the aging legacy facility. Note: Primary physical repair, mechanical completion, and prime construction execution are administered by the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE). The Contractor shall not draft new architectural designs, stamp or seal engineering drawings, or execute physical facility redesigns. 6. Scope: The Government requires an independent, third-party technical Commissioning Agent (Owner's Advocate) to bridge the technical divide between USACE/prime construction execution and the stringent operational, biosafety, and regulatory compliance requirements of the end-user (USAMRDC Headquarters and USAMRIID). The Commissioning Agent will independently evaluate, witness, and verify critical facility systems and controls, and systematically advise the Government on executing a staggered/phased transition to achieve functional occupancy, biosafety accreditation, and facility registration. How to Respond: Please submit a Capability Statement that describes relevant experience, expertise, and capabilities based upon the size and scope of this requirement as outlined in the draft Statement of Objectives (SOO). Capability statements will be reviewed/evaluated for (1) Relevant experience based on the size and scope of the outlined requirement; (2) Company specific capabilities that match the work outlined in the draft SOO. The Government will utilize the capability statements and market data collected from this notice to determine whether the proposed acquisition can be set aside for small business concerns (including 8(a), Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB), Women-Owned Small Business (WOSB), or HUBZone programs) or if full and open competition is required under NAICS code 541330. The formal closing date for this RFI/SS and for the submission of all responses is NLT 9 November 2026 at 12:00PM ET. All responses shall be submitted electronically using PDF or MS Word formats to the POC, Elizabeth O�Hara at elizabeth.m.ohara3.civ@health.mil. All responses received will be considered; however, a determination by the Government not to solicit the proposed requirement based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. The Government reserves the right to continue market research and may issue additional RFIs if deemed necessary. Each response should include the following information and must not be more than fifteen (15) pages in length: Business Information: Company name, mailing address, e-mail address, telephone, website address (if available), and the name, telephone number, and e-mail address of a point of contact having the authority and knowledge to clarify responses with Government representatives. Unique Entity ID number, CAGE Code, and company structure (Corporation, LLC, partnership, joint venture, etc.). Companies also must be registered in System for Award Management (SAM, at www.sam.gov) to be considered as potential sources. Any and all Government Contracts/IDIQs (e.g. Federal Supply Schedule, OASIS+, etc.) you currently hold (to include the vehicle and your contract number) that could be used to fulfill this requirement. Highlight your experience with continuous negative pressure cascades, Bubble Tight Dampers (BTDs), APR doors, chemical suit shower skids and effluent decontamination systems. This Signature Availability is solicited on a coast-wide basis on the West Coast under a single solicitation, and one (1) contract to complete the availability is expected to be awarded to one (1) contractor. Offerors shall review Section L, General Information for further details. ***END NOTICE***The Government anticipates making a single award in or before March 2027. REQUIREMENTS 3.1 Cage Code/Reference Number Items - The PRIMARY RADAR ANTEN furnished under this contract/purchase order shall be the design represented by Cage Code(s) reference number(s). Cage _______ ref. no. ;34228 100148; 3.2 Marking - This item shall be physically identified in accordance with ;MIL-STD-130, REV N, 16 NOV 2012; . 3.3 Changes in Design, Material Servicing, or Part Number - Except for a Code 1 change, which shall be processed as provided in the code statement shown below, no substitution of items shall be made until the NAVICP-MECH Contracting Officer has notified and approval has been given by issuance of a written change order. When any change in design, material, servicing or part number is made to replace or substitute any item to be furnished on this contract/purchase order, the Contractor shall furnish, for the substituting/replacement item, a drawing and an explanation of the reason for the change, explaining the reason therefor. If finished detail drawings are not available, shop drawings in the form used by the manufacturer will be acceptable for Government evaluation. When notifying the Procurement Contracting Officer of the reasons for making substitutions, the type of change shall be indicated by code number in accordance with one of the following statements: Code 1: PART NUMBER CHANGE ONLY - If the Manufacturer's Part Number indicated thereon has changed, but the parts are identical in all respects, supply the item and advise NAVICP-MECH immediately of the new part number. Code 2: Assembly (or set or kit) not furnished - Used following detail parts. Code 3: Part not furnished separately - Use assembly. Code 4: Part redesigned - Old and new parts are completely interchangeable. Code 5: Part redesigned - New part replaces old. Old part cannot replace new. Code 6: Part redesigned - Parts not interchangeable. 3.4 Mercury Free - The material supplied under this contract/purchase order is intended for use on submarines/surface ships and therefore shall contain no metallic mercury and shall be free from mercury contamination. Mercury contamination of the material will be cause for rejection. If the inclusion of metallic mercury is required as a functional part of the material furnished under this contract, the Contractor shall obtain written approval from the Procurement Contracting Officer before proceeding with manufacture. The contractor's request shall explain in detail the requirements for mercury, identify specifically the parts to contain mercury, and explain the method of protection against mercury escape. Such a request will be forwarded directly to the Procurement Contracting Officer with a copy to the applicable Government Inspector. Upon approval by the Contracting Officer, the vendor will provide a "Warning Plate" stating that metallic mercury is a functional part of the item and will include name and location of that part. The use of mercury, mercury compounds, or mercury-bearing instruments and/or equipment in a manner which might cause contamination in the manufacture, assembly, or test of material on this contract is prohibited. The most probable causes of contamination are direct-connected manometers, mercury vacuum pumps, mercury seals, or the handling of mercury in the immediate vicinity. Mercury switches, mercury in glass thermometers, standard cells and other items containing mercury may be used if they are located so as not to constitute a contamination hazard. If external contamination by metallic mercury occurs or is suspected, the following test may be used to determine whether contamination by metallic mercury exists or whether corrective cleaning measures have been effective. Enclose the equipment in a polyethylene bag or close-fitting airtight container for eight hours at room temperature (70 degrees F minimum).Sample the trapped air and if mercury vapor concentration is 0.01 mg/cu meter or more, the material is mercury contaminated insofar as the requirements of this contract are concerned. These requirements shall be included in any subcontract or purchase order hereunder and the Contractor shall insure SubContractor compliance with these requirements. Technical questions pertaining to these requirements shall be referred to the Procurement Contracting Officer via the cognizant Administrative Contracting Officer. For background, the following information is provided: Mercury is corrosive to gold, silver, nickel, stainless steels, aluminum and copper alloys. Stainless steels, nickel, and copper alloys are widely used in reactor plants and other submarine/surface ship systems. Accidental trapping of mercury in a component could cause serious damage to vital parts. Mercury is also toxic if inhaled, ingested, or absorbed through the skin. It is evident that grave consequences could result from small amounts of mercury vapor present in an unreplenished submarine/surface ship atmosphere. 4. title: Government-Owned Contractor Operated (GOCO) Aircraft/Ground Fuel Services and Fuel Storage and Distribution at Cannon AFB, NM, Holloman AFB, NM, Davis Monthan AFB, AZ and Luke AFB, AZ
description: Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) Energy is issuing a Request for Proposal (RFP) for Alongside Aircraft Refueling Services to include managing, maintaining, and operating Government Owned, Contractor-Operated (GOCO) facilities and equipment at Cannon, AFB, NM, Holloman AFB, NM, Davis Monthan AFB, AZ, and Luke AFB, AZ. The Contractor will ensure safe, accurate, and timely handling, quality control, and accountability of all Defense Wide Working Capital Fund (DWWCF)-owned petroleum products under their control. The Contractor will perform required maintenance to ensure facilities, associated systems, vehicles, and equipment remain operational to meet the base mission. The Contractor will comply with environmental protection, safety, and security directives. The Contractor will conduct required training to ensure personnel are fully qualified to perform Performance Work Statement (PWS) tasks. The Contractor shall conduct all necessary fuels operations to support base operations, airshows and special events, deployments, exercises, and contingencies under normal conditions, as well as, during periods of heightened security, inclement weather, or other unique situations. Operations must be safely and efficiently conducted to receive, store, transfer, issue, and account for products with appropriate controls to ensure fuel quality, maintain inventory accuracy, and ensure no environmental impact. The Contractor shall operate and maintain the self-service automated service station facilities, equipment, and systems and ensure sufficient product is available to provide 24 hours a day, seven days a week support of ground fuels. The Contractor shall perform required tasks to ensure fuel is properly accounted for and issued to only authorized users. This procurement will be 100% set aside for Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Business (SDVOSB) under NAICS code 493190 (Other Warehouse and Storage). The Government anticipates issuing one solicitation and awarding four (4) firm fixed-price contracts for Cannon AFB, NM, Holloman AFB, NM, Davis Monthan AFB, AZ, and Luke AFB, AZ. These requirements will be for a four-year base period (December 01, 2026 � November 30, 2030), a five-year option period (December 01, 2030 � November 30, 2035), and a option to extend the contract s for up to six individual months (December 01, 2035 � May 31, 2036).This procurement will be solicited under full and open competition after exclusion of sources. The solicitation will be published electronically on the SAM website at https://sam.gov/. Interested companies responding to the solicitation will be required to register in the System for Award Management (SAM) and Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment (PIEE). Dates of the Pre-Preproposal conference, in conjunction with the site visits, will be listed in the solicitation or via amendment. Offerors will be required to submit in writing to the Contract Specialist (via e-mail) the name(s) of the individual(s) who plan to attend.

This announcement constitutes the only solicitation. OAers are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation Number W912P727QA002 is issued as a request for quotation (RFQ) for the monitoring and evaluation of Russian River coho salmon and related services. This acquisition is full and open. The full text of provisions and clauses may be accessed electronically at https://acquisition.gov/far-overhaul/far-part-deviation-guide. Project Description: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) San Francisco District is seeking to contract a non-personnel service contract to provide monitoring and evaluation of the Russian River Coho Salmon Captive Broodstock Program (RRCSCBP) located at Don Clausen Fish Hatchery (Sonoma County). The contractor shall make sure that work is accomplished in accordance with the contract and all applicable laws municipal codes regulations and/or written directives issued by the Contracting OAicer. The provisions at 52.212-1 Instructions to OAerors-Commercial Products and Commercial Services 52.212-2 Evaluation-Commercial Products and Commercial Services and 52.212-4 Contract Terms and Conditions-Commercial Products and Commercial Services apply to this acquisition. title: Loaded Cartridge Assembly (MC91) for MK 5 Mod ) Explosive Bolt
description: This announcement should not be construed as a commitment by the U.S. Government. The U.S. Navy does not intend to award a contract based on this Request for Information/Sources Sought Notice. THIS IS NOT A Request for a Proposal AND DOES NOT OBLIGATE THE U.S. GOVERNMENT TO ISSUE an RFP. This RFI is for U.S. Government planning purposes only and constitutes requests for exchange of information pursuant to FAR Part 10. The Naval Surface Warfare Center, Indian Head Division (NSWC IHD), Contracts Department, Code 02 is conducting Market Research on the Loaded Cartridge Assembly, DODIC MC91. NSWC IHD is conducting a market survey to identify sources/vendors capable of supplying the MC91 cartridge satisfying the following requirements: 1. The cartridge needs to meet the criteria specified by WS6061 and WS6052, ADL 2429839, their lower-tier documents, and be compatible with the MK 5 MOD 0 Explosive Bolt (M254), a critical component on the AN/BST-1 Buoy system. The Technical Data Package (TDP) contains technical data whose export is restricted by the Arms Export Control Act (Title 22, U.S.C., Sec 2751, et seq.). To receive the TDP, interested vendors must submit a written request accompanied by an approved DD Form 2345 (Military Critical Technical Data Agreement), signed NDA, and active CAGE code. 2. Contractor must be able to stand up a manufacturing line and be able to support the U.S. Government by providing all deliveries within one year of award. 3. Procurement includes production units (QTY 100) as well as all associated destructive test samples required for qualification and acceptance. This procurement includes the manufacture, testing (including nondestructive testing (NDT/radiographic) capabilities), packaging, and delivery of the MC91 Cartridge Assembly. Request your company provide responses to the following questionnaire: Does your company have a production line available that can meet the requirements mentioned above? If yes, describe your company's history and experience with supplying this item (or similar cartridges for explosive bolts) including the total number supplied to date and how the facilities are ready to support USG requirements. What is your company�s availability of inert metal parts or existing validated energetic loading lines? If the MC91 cartridges are not currently in stock, when would they be available for delivery? How many days or months after an award? Can your Company provide the rate of production the manufacturing facility is capable of per year? Can your company provide a Rough Order of Magnitude (ROM) unit price estimate based on the stated quantity of 100 production units plus required test samples, along with estimated stepped pricing for higher production rates? Do test reports exist that demonstrate the MC91 (or similar cartridges for explosive bolts) manufacturing accuracy and reliability? Actual reports are not required to be submitted as part of this request for information but will be accepted after your initial response to this request. Are you able to supply documented ability of your company's MC91 cartridges to function reliably with the MK 5 MOD 0 Explosive Bolt? Does your facility hold the necessary ATF licensing, Net Explosive Weight (NEW) storage capacity, and compliance with DoD 4145.26-M to manufacture, assemble, and store loaded MC91 cartridges? Describe your inspection capabilities for energetic components, specifically hermetic seal testing (helium leak rate) and real-time radiography (X-ray) for internal explosive pellet/column alignment. What are the lead times for primary energetic ingredients/mixes and specialized metal hardware required by WS6061 and WS6052? Are any materials obsolete or sole-sourced? Does your company possess or capability to produce all tooling, crimping dies, and electrical/bridgewire resistance test fixtures required to manufacture this item, or would Government-Furnished Equipment/Tooling (GFE/GFT) be required? Small Business Subcontracting & Nonmanufacturer Rule Compliance: If responding as a Small Business prime under NAICS 325920, please clarify your manufacturing approach: Does your company intend to perform at least 50% of the cost of manufacturing (excluding material costs) in-house at your own safety-approved facility? If you do not manufacture the cartridges in-house, do you intend to source the MC91 cartridges from another domestic small business manufacturer? If you intend to partner with a large business manufacturer, are you aware of the requirements to obtain an individual SBA Nonmanufacturer Rule (NMR) waiver prior to solicitation close? All interested sources shall provide the organization name, address, point of contact, phone number, e-mail address, business size, Unique Entity ID, and CAGE Code. In addition, all interested sources shall provide a summary of their company�s capabilities and delivery timeframe and schedule. All responding sources must email their response submissions no later than 17:00 Eastern Time on November 9, 2026 to the Point of Contacts (POCs) listed below. Submissions must be in PDF format and shall not exceed fifteen (15) pages in total. 1) NSWC IHD Attn: Michael Persinger Picatinny Arsenal, NJ 07806 Michael.a.persinger2.civ@us.navy.mil 2) NSWC IHD Attn: Gerardo Ilaria Picatinny Arsenal, NJ 07806-5000 gerardo.ilaria.civ@us.navy.mil

Accidental trapping of mercury in a component could cause serious damage to vital parts. Mercury is also toxic if inhaled, ingested, or absorbed through the skin. description: **QUESTIONS ARE DUE NO LATER THAN COB 19 OCTOBER** Depending on interest a site visit can be scheduled and proposal due date MAY shift to accommodate. This SOW defines the requirement for the Contractor to Engineer, Furnish, Install and Test (EFI&T) new 12-Strand (St), Single Mode (SM) Fiber Optic Cable (FOC) from Radar Approach Control (RAPCON, B979) to Air Traffic Control Tower (ATCT, B998), Base Operation (Ops)B453), Command Post (CP, B11), Localizer (B1375), Glide Slope (GS, B1056), Tactical Air Navigation (TACAN, B1049), Ground Antenna Transmit and Receive (GATR, B1040), Glide Slope (B1081 and Localizer (B1059). Also, 12-St SM FOC from Base Ops (B453) to Primary and Secondary Automatic Meteorological Station (FMQ-19s). The work will be performed at Luke AFB AZ by using new and existing Manhole/Handhole Duct System. Some portion of the cable route/path will be Direct Buried. The Contractor shall provide all equipment, tools, materials, supplies, transportation, labor, supervision, management, and other incidentals necessary to meet the requirements as stated in this SOW. All equipment, supplies, or materials provided shall be new and not refurbished. No equipment, supplies, or material will be provided by the government. All materials used in this SOW must be rust-proof and corrosion-resistant, due to the nature of the environment. See attached Solicitation and supporting documents for additional information.

description: This SOW defines the requirement for the Contractor to Engineer, Furnish, Install and Test (EFI&T) new 12-Strand (St), Single Mode (SM) Fiber Optic Cable (FOC) from Radar Approach Control (RAPCON, B979) to Air Traffic Control Tower (ATCT, B998), Base Operation (Ops)B453), Command Post (CP, B11), Localizer (B1375), Glide Slope (GS, B1056), Tactical Air Navigation (TACAN, B1049), Ground Antenna Transmit and Receive (GATR, B1040), Glide Slope (B1081 and Localizer (B1059). Also, 12-St SM FOC from Base Ops (B453) to Primary and Secondary Automatic Meteorological Station (FMQ-19s). The work will be performed at Luke AFB AZ by using new and existing Manhole/Handhole Duct System. Some portion of the cable route/path will be Direct Buried. The Contractor shall provide all equipment, tools, materials, supplies, transportation, labor, supervision, management, and other incidentals necessary to meet the requirements as stated in this SOW. All equipment, supplies, or materials provided shall be new and not refurbished. No equipment, supplies, or material will be provided by the government. All materials used in this SOW must be rust-proof and corrosion-resistant, due to the nature of the environment. See attached Solicitation and supporting documents for additional information.

Federal Agency: Air Force Program Office: AFLCMC/XA �Architecture and Integration Directorate� CSO Title: JADC2 Commercial Solutions Opening CSO Type: Commercial Solutions Opening with Calls CSO Number: FA8612-21-S-C001 CSO Date: June 28, 2021 NOTE This is only an announcement; PLEASE DO NOT SUBMIT PROPOSALS IN RESPONSE. Subsequent calls will be issued under this announcement to solicit proposals for specific efforts. Please refer to the attachment section of this announcement for the calls. Publication of this announcement does not obligate the DoD to review any white papers submission beyond an initial administrative review, or to award any specific project, or to obligate any available funds. 1.0 OVERVIEW This Commercial Solutions Opening is intended to be as streamlined as possible to allow the Architecture and Integration Directorate (AFLCMC/XA), or any organization AFLCMC/XA supports, to leverage the latest technology advances from a large variety of prospective Contractors. AFLCMC/XA invites innovative technical approach proposals addressing Joint All-Domain Command and Control (JADC2) problems associated with getting the right information to the right platform/decision maker in the most efficient manner thereby reducing kill chain and Observe, Orient, Decide and Act (OODA) timelines and cycles. This Commercial Solutions Opening will focus on existing and emerging technologies and platforms across the Defense Department, the Intelligence Community, and the commercial world, to perform an integrated analysis of the capability of various options to contribute to the fight and prioritize investments over time. This solicitation is not requesting any white papers or proposals at this time. This Commercial Solutions Opening functions as the overarching umbrella solicitation from which Calls will be published. This Commercial Solutions Opening will remain open for Calls until rescinded. This Commercial Solutions Opening can result in the award of FAR Part 12 Contracts, Procurement for experimental purposes under 10 U.S.C. 4023 or Other Transaction Agreements (OTAs) under 10 USC 4021. Over the course of this time period, AFLCMC/XA will publish Calls via amendments to this Commercial Solutions Opening. These Calls will contain specific Areas of Interest (AoIs) related to JADC2�s Technology Focus Areas. Those specific AoIs are what prospective Contractors shall focus their solutions towards. This is a competitive solicitation that seeks to fund innovative technologies that propose new solutions to expand Air Force capabilities as it relates to JADC2 Technology Focus Areas. AFLCMC/XA is interested in receiving responses from all interested offerors to include, but not limited to, the following: traditional defense contractors, nontraditional defense contractors, large businesses, small businesses and research institutions. The Commercial Solutions Opening is a streamlined acquisition process that seeks to reduce acquisition timelines and acquire new, innovative solutions that companies can bring forth to meet the stated AoIs detailed in each Call. All details of the process shall be governed by this Commercial Solutions Opening unless otherwise noted or expanded upon in each Call. AFLCMC/XA is not obligated to make any awards as a result of this Commercial Solutions Opening and all awards are subject to the availability of funds and successful negotiations. The Government is not responsible for any monies expended by the proposer prior to the issuance of any contract award. AFLCMC/XA reserves the right to modify the solicitation requirements of this Commercial Solutions Opening and each subsequent Call. The Commercial Solutions Opening authority reference to Class Deviation 2022-O0007. 2.0 Commercial Solutions Opening with Calls This Commercial Solutions Opening is a hybrid solicitation against which both Closed Calls and/or Open Period Calls can be published via amendments to the Commercial Solutions Opening. All Calls issued under this Commercial Solutions Opening will include specific instructions including dates, AoIs, evaluation criteria and proposal instructions to potential offerors. While each offeror shall adhere to this Commercial Solutions Opening, the Calls can contain other information the Contractor shall adhere to. Each Call will be announced on the Government Point of Entry (beta.SAM.gov), which may result in the award of a FAR Part 12, Procurement for experimental purposes under 10 U.S.C. 4023 contract or an Other Transaction Agreement (OTA) under 10 USC 4021. 2.1 Closed Calls (One-Step or Two-Step) Over the period of this Commercial Solutions Opening, Calls may be issued to request white papers and/or proposals for specific AoIs. It will be determined on a Call-by-Call basis whether or not the announcement is for a one-step (Proposals only) or a two-step process (White Papers first, then Proposals by invite-only). The submission for white papers and proposals shall be submitted at a specific date and time as set forth in each particular Call. White papers and/or proposals will not be reviewed if submitted after the stated date and time. No exceptions will be made for late proposal submission, including technology issues encountered during submission. One-Step Calls Step 1: Proposal due date and time will be provided in Calls issued against this Commercial Solutions Opening. Two-Step Calls Step 1: White Paper due date and time will be provided in Calls issued against this Commercial Solutions Opening Step 2: Proposal due date and time will be provided in Requests for Proposals (RFPs) sent to offerors that submit White Papers who are evaluated well in accordance with the criteria stated in each Call. 2.2 Open Period Calls (Two-Step) This Commercial Solutions Opening may also have Open Period Calls. Open Period Calls will only be issued under a two-step process. After an Open Call is published, white papers may be submitted at any time during an Open Period for the AoIs detailed in the Call. It is important to note that only white papers submitted in response to the specific AoIs detailed in the Call will be considered. title: Italy – Data-processing services – Procedura aperta sopra soglia comunitaria, ai sensi dell'art. 71 del d.lgs. n. 36/2023 , articolata un unico lotto, per l'affidamento dei servizi per la rendicontazione delle opere musicali e dei supporti fonografici utilizzati nei programmi trasmessi da Rai.
description: I servizi oggetto di appalto consistono nel riconoscimento, identificazione, completamento informativo e rendicontazione delle Opere Musicali e dei relativi Supporti discografici utilizzati nei programmi radiotelevisivi e nelle trasmissioni radiofoniche Rai, mediante l'utilizzo di sistemi automatici di riconoscimento, banche dati specialistiche e attività di validazione e controllo, al fine di consentire il corretto adempimento degli obblighi previsti dalla normativa applicabile e dagli accordi di licenza nei confronti delle Collecting. Nell'ambito del servizio il Fornitore dovrà, tra l'altro: • acquisire e monitorare i flussi audio/video e i dati necessari alla rendicontazione; • riconoscere e identificare le Opere Musicali e i relativi Supporti mediante sistemi automatici di riconoscimento e le ulteriori metodologie previste dal Capitolato Tecnico; • completare, verificare e aggiornare i metadati necessari alla rendicontazione; • predisporre, trasmettere e rettificare i Cue Sheet secondo il tracciato previsto; • gestire la Black List, i File Scarti e le attività di bonifica e correzione; • produrre la reportistica e le evidenze richieste da Rai ai fini delle verifiche e dei controlli. I servizi comprendono altresì le attività di avvio, messa a regime, supporto operativo e transizione in uscita necessarie a garantire la continuità e la corretta esecuzione del processo di rendicontazione. Rai si riserva la facoltà di richiedere, in tutto o in parte, i seguenti servizi “a richiesta”: a) rendicontazione delle Opere Musicali e dei Supporti relativi alla programmazione dei canali attualmente contraddistinti dal marchio "Rai Italia"; b) riconoscimento e rendicontazione delle Opere Musicali e dei Supporti relativi a contenuti presenti sulla piattaforma "RaiPlay"; c) riconoscimento e rendicontazione delle Opere Musicali e dei Supporti relativi a contenuti presenti sulla piattaforma "RaiPlay Sound"; d) riconoscimento e rendicontazione delle Opere Musicali e dei Supporti relativi a programmi già trasmessi in periodi antecedenti la durata contrattuale sui canali generalisti televisivi e radiofonici. In tali casi Rai metterà a disposizione del Fornitore la possibilità di ascoltare e/o visionare le relative registrazioni; e) riconoscimento e rendicontazione delle Opere Musicali e dei Supporti relativi a programmi già trasmessi in periodi antecedenti la durata contrattuale sui canali tematici, regionali e dedicati alle minoranze linguistiche televisivi e radiofonici. In tali casi Rai metterà a disposizione del Fornitore la possibilità di ascoltare e/o visionare le relative registrazioni; f) elaborazioni e analisi relative alla rappresentatività delle Collecting con riferimento a specifici canali, palinsesti e/o periodi temporali; g) segmentazione della programmazione televisiva ai fini dell'individuazione dell'effettivo orario di messa in onda dei programmi; h) segmentazione della programmazione radiofonica ai fini dell'individuazione dell'effettivo orario di messa in onda dei programmi; i) completamento e integrazione dei dati Rai relativi alle Dichiarazioni Contenuti Programmi (DCP); j) integrazione e riconciliazione dei dati rilevati dal Fornitore con le informazioni relative agli utilizzi musicali contenute nelle Dichiarazioni Contenuti Programmi (DCP) predisposte da Rai. Per la dettagliata descrizione delle caratteristiche tecniche e funzionali dei servizi in oggetto, nonché delle modalità di esecuzione degli stessi si rimanda al Capitolato Tecnico di gara. - ai sensi dell’art. 58 del Codice ed in applicazione dei principi in materia, la procedura è articolata in un unico lotto per le seguenti motivazioni: (i) le prestazioni oggetto dell'affidamento costituiscono un processo unitario e fortemente integrato di riconoscimento, identificazione, completamento informativo e rendicontazione delle Opere Musicali e dei relativi dati fonografici, che richiede la gestione unitaria e omogenea di una medesima Banca Dati al fine di garantire coerenza, univocità e uniformità dei risultati della rendicontazione; (ii) l'esecuzione delle prestazioni presuppone l'utilizzo di un'unica metodologia operativa, di un unico sistema di riconoscimento e di un'unica integrazione applicativa tra i sistemi del Fornitore e quelli della Committente, nonché la gestione coordinata dei Cue Sheet, della Black List, degli Scarti e delle Rettifiche, attività che presentano un elevato grado di interdipendenza tecnica ed operativa; (iii) l'eventuale suddivisione in lotti comporterebbe la necessità di coordinare operatori economici diversi, potenzialmente dotati di differenti banche dati, sistemi di riconoscimento, criteri di classificazione e processi di aggiornamento, con conseguente rischio di disallineamenti informativi, duplicazioni di attività, inefficienze operative e incremento dei costi di coordinamento e controllo; (iv) la gestione unitaria del servizio consente inoltre di perseguire obiettivi di efficienza organizzativa ed economicità dell'azione contrattuale, evitando la frammentazione delle responsabilità e garantendo un presidio omogeneo dell'intero processo di rendicontazione.

title: Germany – Canal construction – Stadt Königswinter – Beseitigung Bahnübergang Drachenfelsstraße - Entwässerungsarbeiten für Rampenanlage mit Bau eines Stauraumkanals mit Pumpstation
description: In der Stadt Königswinter befindet sich der beliebte Ausflugsberg Drachenfels. Dazu kommen die Besucher meist mit dem Schiff über den Rhein bis nach Königswinter und gehen dann auf direktem Weg über die Drachenfelsstraße und dem Bahnübergang (BÜ) „Drachenfelsstraße“ hoch zum Drachenfels bzw. zur Talstation der Drachenfelsbahn (bergseitig). Dabei werden neben der Bundesstraße B 42 auch die Eisenbahnstrecke 2324 von Mülheim (Ruhr)-Speldorf nach Niederlahnstein in Bahn-km 99.127 und 99.212 über den Bahnübergang (BÜ) gequert. Die Strecke 2324 ist mit über 300 Zugfahrten die am meisten belastete Eisenbahnstrecke in Deutschland. Da seit Frühjahr 2026 ein neues Eisenbahnüberführungsbauwerk (als Unterführung - EÜ) als Ersatz für den vorhandenen BÜ hergestellt wird, sind für das geplante, bergseitige Aufgangsbauwerk (Rampen- und Treppenanlage) vorab die vorbereitenden Kanalbaumaßnahmen durchzuführen. Vorliegend werden die Arbeiten zur Entwässerung / Kanalbau ausgeschrieben. Die herzustellenden Kanalanlagen befinden sich zwischen der Unterführung der Bahntrasse und dem Aufgangsbauwerk hangseits zwischen Tunnelausgang und den Straßen Winzerstraße und Drachenfelsstraße.

title: Bulgaria – Construction work for airports – ИЗПЪЛНЕНИЕ НА СТРОИТЕЛНО-МОНТАЖНИ РАБОТИ НА ОБЕКТ „1450/ПИР – ПРОЕКТИРАНЕ И РЕМОНТ НА ПЪТЕКИ ЗА РУЛИРАНЕ И МЕСТОСТОЯНКИ ВЪВ ВОЕННО ФОРМИРОВАНИЕ 26030 - БЕЗМЕР“
description: Предметът на настоящата обществена поръчка е изпълнение на строително-монтажни работи на обект „1450/ПиР – Проектиране и ремонт на пътеки за рулиране и местостоянки във военно формирование 26030 - Безмер“, включително изготвяне на екзекутивната документация след изпълнението на обекта. Ремонтът на пътеките за рулиране и местотстоянката, следва да осигури изпълнението на изискванията за използване на инфраструктурата на цялото летателно поле от самолет F-16 Blok 70 и носенето на съвместно дежурство по Air Policing със съюзни военновъздушни сили. Изграждането на нов инженерен команден пункт следва да създаде условия за по-голяма оперативност при използване на летището за провеждане на регулярна летателна дейност на националните ВВС и съвместно със съюзни военновъздушни сили. Строително-монтажните работи следва да се извършват в съответствие с изискванията на инвестиционен проект (Приложение № 21) и количествено-стойностната сметка към него (Приложение № 22) от документацията за участие (Документацията). Технически показатели: 1. Подобект 1 "Ремонт на пътеки за рулиране и местостоянки във военно формирование 26 030 - Безмер": Широчината на пътеките за рулиране е 18 м с изключение на пътеката за рулиране (югоизточно от централизирана стоянка), водеща до съществуваща бетонна прощадка, която е с ширина 16 м. Около пътеките за рулиране се предвижда банкет с ширина минимум 6 м, оформени като подравнена уплътнена тревна площ. Ценрализираната стоянка е с обща площ 10 350 кв.м. 2. Подобект 2 "Изграждане на инженерен команден пункт във военно формирование 26 030 - Безмер": Предвидено е изграждане на обслужваща сграда – команден пункт, с три експлоатационни нива, без сутерен. В сградата е предвидено да работят 40 човека персонал. Около сградата на командния център е предвиден тротоар с широчина, равна или по-голяма от 1,50 м. Застроена площ 257,99 кв.м. Разгъната застроена площ 545,81 кв.м. Площ на имота по КККР 4 265 771,00 кв.м. title: Bulgaria – Various surface works – „Възстановяване на пътни и тротоарни настилки на територията на град София“, реф. № РРС 26-108
description: „Електроразпределителни мрежи Запад“ ЕАД провежда процедура от вида „договаряне с предварителна покана за участие“ с предмет: „Възстановяване на пътни и тротоарни настилки на територията на град София“, реф. № РРС 26-108. Предметът на обществената поръчка е разделен на 4 (четири) обособени позиции, както следва: Обособена позиция № 1: „Възстановяване на пътни и тротоарни настилки на територията на град София – ОЦ „Север“. Обособена позиция № 1 обхваща територията и ще се изпълнява в следните райони на Столична община: Сердика, Подуяне, Слатина, Кремиковци, Оборище и Надежда. Обособена позиция № 2: „Възстановяване на пътни и тротоарни настилки на територията на град София – ОЦ „Запад“. Обособена позиция № 2 обхваща територията и ще се изпълнява в следните райони на Столична община: Нови Искър, Люлин, Възраждане, Връбница, Банкя, Илинден и Красна поляна. Обособена позиция № 3: „Възстановяване на пътни и тротоарни настилки на територията на град София – ОЦ „Изток“. Обособена позиция № 3 обхваща територията и ще се изпълнява в следните райони на Столична община: Младост, Искър, Панчарево, Изгрев, Средец, Студентски град и на територията на община Самоков (в.з. Ярема и м.Стената). Обособена позиция № 4: „Възстановяване на пътни и тротоарни настилки на територията на град София – ОЦ „Юг“. Обособена позиция № 4 обхваща територията и ще се изпълнява в следните райони на Столична община: Лозенец, Красно село, Триадица, Витоша и Овча купел. Всеки кандидат/участник може да участва за всички обособени позиции (една или повече обособени позиции, до максималния брой обособени позиции по предмета на поръчката). Възложителят не ограничава броя на обособените позиции, които могат да бъдат възложени на един и същ изпълнител. Критерият за възлагане на настоящата обществена поръчка при определяне на икономически най-изгодната оферта е „най-ниска цена”. Класирането на участниците се извършва за всяка обособена позиция поотделно. На първо място по съответната обособена позиция се класира участникът, предложил най-ниска обща цена за изпълнение на поръчката. Договор се сключва с класирания на първо място участник за съответната обособена позиция. Срокът на договора за всяка обособена позиция е 24 (двадесет и четири) месеца, считано от датата, на която е сключен или до достигане на максималната стойност на договора, в зависимост от това, кое от така посочените събития ще настъпи първо по време. Категорията на строежите, попадащи в обхвата на всяка една обособена позиция на настоящата обществена поръчка, са пета категория съгласно чл. 137, ал. 1, т. 5 от Закона за устройство на територията. Част от основните видове строително-монтажни работи (СМР) и обобщени количества за четирите обособени позиции, включват: Разкъртване и възстановяване на тротоарни и базалтови плочи – нови, включително материалите – 2800 м2; Възстановяване на асфалт /задължително заливане на контура с разтопен битум/ – 3200 м2; Възстановяване на бетонни настилки – 440 м2; Ремонт на двойна шахта с р-ри 140/100/90 см – 180 бр.; Направа на тройна шахта с р-ри 210/100/90 см – 56 бр.; Възстановяване на паважни настилки – 220 м2; Възстановяване на бордюри със стари – 200 м; Двукратно боядисване по метални повърхности – 200 м2; Изработка и монтаж на армировка с обикновенна и средна сложност от 6÷12 мм. от А1 и А2 – 1440 кг.; Доставка и полагане на бетон Б 20 – 80 м3. Монтаж на метална конструкция – 520 кг; Възстановяване на мазилката около главно електромерно табло (ГЕТ) във вход – 120 м2; Двукратно боядисване на стени около ГЕТ във вход – 120 м2 и други видове СМР, които подробно са описани в количествената сметка за съответната обособена позиция, приложена към Техническите спецификации и изисквания на Възложителя, съответно в количествено-стойностната сметка за съответната обособена позиция, приложена към ценовото предложение от документацията за обществената поръчка. Изпълнението на договора за всяка обособена позиция ще се извършва в зависимост от техническата готовност на Възложителя за възлагане на изпълнението. За възлагане на конкретните видове работи Възложителят съставя документ за възлагане на изпълнението, съдържащ най-малко следната информация: видовете работи и количеството им, срок за изпълнение, цената на база единичните цени и друга информация, необходима за изпълнение на видовете дейности. Документът за възлагане на изпълнението се подписва от Възложителя и Изпълнителя, по ред и начин, описани в проекта на договор. Приемането на изпълнената работа по всеки документ за възлагане на изпълнението се извършва с приемателен протокол, подписан от двете страни по договора, по ред и начин, описани в проекта на договор.

title: Contract Opportunity Network Enabled Weapons Trainer (NEWT)
description: DISCLAIMER: THIS IS A REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI)/ SOURCES SOUGHT FOR WHITE PAPERS ONLY. THERE IS NO SOLICITATION AT THIS TIME. The Naval Air Systems Command (NAVAIR) is conducting market research to identify potential industry sources and commercial-off-the-shelf (COTS) capabilities. The PMX-201 Precision Strike Weapons, Effects Deployment Office (FXDO), Network Enabled Weapons Trainer (NEWT) Program requests interested parties submit a white paper detailing their proposed approach or existing capability to develop, manufacture, and maintain an airworthy, Aircraft Carrier suitable store[JN1] [CM2] that will emulate all Air launched DOW Network Enabled Weapons (NEW). SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS: Format: White papers must be submitted in PDF/Microsoft Word format. Page Limit: Responses shall not exceed 8 pages, excluding the cover page. Font: Times New Roman or Arial, 11-point font or larger. Deadline: All submissions must be received no later than (NLT) Date will be determined 09 November 2026, 5 pm Eastern Standard Time. Delivery: Submit via email to breanne.n.jilcott.civ@us.navy.mil with the subject line: Response to N00019-25-RFPREQ-WPM201-0360 � Company Name The Government acknowledges that white papers may contain proprietary or trade secret information. All proprietary information contained in the response must be clearly marked. The Government will safeguard properly marked proprietary information from unauthorized disclosure in accordance with applicable laws and regulations. Please do not submit classified information or pricing information in response to this RFI. Please provide the following information: 1. Company Name and Address 2. Cage Code and UEI Number 3. Company business size by NAICS code 4. Small Business Type(s), if applicable 5. Point of Contact for questions and/or clarifications (Name, Title, Phone, Email) 6. Telephone Number and email address 7. Web Page URL (if applicable) 8. Teaming Partners (if applicable) 9. Information regarding the viability to receive and process classified information with appropriate contact information 10. Provide any recommendations and/or concerns. 11. Location(s) of work to be performed. Capabilities Statement: � Provide a detailed description of your company's experience, capabilities, and planned approach to develop and manufacture the following: Provide an agnostic Captive Carriage Network Enabled Weapons Trainer (NEWT) to emulate all Network Enabled Weapons (NEWs) employed by aircraft in the DoN inventory. This trainer will have the following: Supportable Platforms The NEWT shall be captive carried from DoN fixed wing platforms that employ Network-Enabled Weapons. The NEWT shall meet exportability requirements to FVEY. Reliability The NEWT shall have a minimum power on time of 4 hrs with a 30 min cool off period for Strike Fighter training, during which the NEWT can be cold soaked at altitude. Maritime Patrol and Reconnaissance Force (MPRF) is 12-hour power-on operations. [JN5] [CM6] This includes power on deck (BIT, Mission Planning download, crypto verification) and power while airborne. BLOS communications are needed pre-employment, employment and post simulated launch of long-range NEWs. Supportability The NEWT shall be capable of off-aircraft BIT/ reprogramming using existing CMBRE or other follow-on systems. The NEWT shall be compatible with existing support equipment and test equipment (GSE). Ground Crew shall be able to change the NEWT to the weapon it is emulating without downloading the NEWT from the aircraft.[JN7] [CM8] The NEWT shall focus on software modularity instead of hardware interchangeability. The NEWT shall not require liquids or gases that need to be refilled. Program Protection The NEWT shall minimize or eliminate weapons CPI content. The NEWT shall meet current AT / Cyber standards for new hardware (if not already flight proven hardware). Environmental/Structural The NEWT shall be designed for the carrier environment. The NEWT shall be designed for a Vmax of 1.2 IMN The NEWT shall be reusable with a maximum down time of 45 minutes between flights. The NEWT life shall maximize the number of catapults and arrestments. Once the NEWT has reached its service life, maintenance actions to return to flying status are limited to the Organizational (O) and Intermediate (I) level maintenance[JN9] [CM10] . Connectivity The NEWT shall utilize all NEW waveforms The NEWT shall be capable of operating between 0-6 GHz including, but not limited to WF L, WF X, WF S, WF Y, and Link-16. buyer: Styrelsen for Grøn Arealomlægning og Vandmiljø
title: EU-udbud af rammeaftale vedrørende kemiske laboratorieanalyser af udvalgte pesticider i grundvand
description: Styrelsen for Grøn Arealomlægning og Vandmiljø udbyder en rammeaftale vedrørende udførelse af kemiske laboratorieanalyser af udvalgte pesticider i grundvand. Der er behov for at udvide NOVANA-overvågningen af pesticider i grundvand med en række udvalgte stoffer. Det præcise omfang er ved at blive afklaret i forbindelse med finanslov 2027 og forventes først endeligt afklaret ultimo 2026. Da prøvetagningen allerede skal opstarte januar 2027, har ordregiver behov for at udbyde aftalen førend de endelige afklaringer omkring økonomi foreligger. På nuværende tidspunkt forventes overvågningen i 2027 som minimum at omfatte analyse for 3 af de 10 udbudte pesticidstoffer. Det forventes, at der som minimum udtages 250 prøver til analyse af de 3 pesticidstoffer. Ordregiver håber at opnå en bevilling, således at analysen kommer til at omfatte alle 10 pesticidstoffer i op til 800 prøver. Da ordregiver ikke forventer at udtage mindre end 250 prøver, evalueres prisen på analyse af alle 10 pesticidstoffer i 250 prøver. Ordregiver har i forvejen to rammeaftaler vedrørende kemisk analyse af miljøfremmede forurenende stoffer i grundvand, hvor den ene omfatter analyse af pesticider. Begge rammeaftaler udløber ultimo 2027. Ordregiver forventer, at eksisterende rammeaftaler, samt rammeaftalen omfattet af dette udbud, bliver udbudt som én samlet rammeaftale i 2028. Der forventes et nyt NOVANA-program i 2028, og da programmet ikke er endeligt fastlagt, udbydes rammeaftalen omfattet af dette udbud alene for år 2027 med mulighed for forlængelse i yderligere ét år, såfremt det kommende NOVANA-program skulle blive forsinket. Prøverne udtages og indleveres på prøveudvekslingsstederne af personale fra ordregivers lokalenheder. Leverandøren skal stå for levering af emballage, afhentning af prøver, transport, analyse og rapportering m.v., som beskrevet i Bilag 1 – Kravspecifikation. Prøveudvekslingsstederne fremgår af Bilag 1.1. Rammeaftalen træder i kraft den 1. januar 2027 og er gældende til den 31. december 2027, med mulighed for forlængelse i yderligere ét år. Rammeaftalens samlede forventede værdi er opgjort til 4 mio. kr. ekskl. moms. Rammeaftalens samlede maksimale værdi er opgjort til 5 mio. kr. ekskl. moms.

De marine sedimentprøver udtages af personale på ordregivers skibe og overleveres til leverandørens kurerer på en række udvalgte prøveudvekslingssteder (havne). Leverandøren skal stå for afhentning af prøver, transport, analyse og rapportering m.v., som beskrevet i Bilag 1 – Kravspecifikation. Prøveudvekslingsstederne fremgår af Bilag 1.1. Rammeaftalen træder i kraft den 1. januar 2027 og er gældende til den 31. december 2027, med mulighed for forlængelse i yderligere 3 gange 1 år. Rammeaftalens samlede forventede værdi er opgjort til 2 mio. kr. ekskl. moms. Rammeaftalens samlede maksimale værdi er opgjort til 2,5 mio. kr. ekskl. moms.

title: Udbud af udlejnings- og ejendomsadministrationssystem
description: I - BAGGRUND OG FORMÅL Bygningsstyrelsen udbyder en kontrakt om tilrådighedsstillelse af en SaaS-løsning til it-understøttelse af ejendomsadministration og udlejning i Bygningsstyrelsen. Bygningsstyrelsen har behov for en løsning, der skal fungere som Bygningsstyrelsens primære fagsystem til it-understøttelse af Bygningsstyrelsens fagcenter for udlejning og asset management. Løsningen skal leveres som en SaaS-løsning med den nødvendige konfiguration med henblik på at understøtte Bygningsstyrelsens behov. Leverandøren skal gennemføre implementering, herunder konfigurering, opsætning og datamigrering fra Bygningsstyrelsens eksisterende system, uddannelse af Bygningsstyrelsens brugere i overensstemmelse med Bygningsstyrelsens behov forud tilrådighedsstillelsen af løsningen. Efter tilrådighedsstillelsen skal Leverandøren levere Servicen inklusive drift, support og vedligeholdelse. Bygningsstyrelsen skal anvende Navision Stat til opkrævning af husleje. Dette understøttes af en ekstern integration, der skal tilgås via et API udstillet af løsningen. Formålet med løsningen er primært, at den skal: - Understøtte Bygningsstyrelsens kerneopgaver inden for udlejning, ejendomsadministration, kontraktadministration og opkrævning, - Fungere som primær kilde for centrale stamdata (ejendomme, bygninger, lejeenheder mv.), som anvendes på tværs af Bygningsstyrelsens forretning, - Understøtte hensigtsmæssig dataregistrering samt sikre sporbarhed og revisions- og kontrolmuligheder, og - indgå i Bygningsstyrelsens samlede it-arkitektur med integrationsplatform og dataplatform samt indgå som en central del af Bygningsstyrelsens samlede systemlandskab og overordnede it- og datastrategi. Det eksisterende system har i dag ca. 10 samtidige brugere og indeholder ca. 5.300 kontrakter. Det er Bygningsstyrelsens forventning, at den kommende løsning efter datamigreringen vil indeholde mellem 2.000 og 2.500 kontrakter. Det eksisterende system indeholder derudover i dag ca. 1.400 ejendomme, 3.200 bygninger, jordarealer og ejendomsobjekter, 500 kunder, 6.300 lejeenheder og 700 private udlejere og/eller administratorer, og der foretages årligt ca. 22.000 opkrævninger, som der skal foretages datamigrering af. II - HOVEDYDELSERNE Kontrakten omfatter følgende hovedydelser: a) Indledende Ydelser: Leverandøren skal i implementeringsfasen gennemføre implementering, herunder foretage konfiguration og opsætning af Løsningen i et tæt samarbejde med Bygningsstyrelsen i overensstemmelse med Bygningsstyrelsens behov, migrering af data samt uddannelse af brugere. b) Løbende Ydelser: Leverandøren skal fra Tilrådighedsstillelsesdagen stille Løsningen til rådighed for Bygningsstyrelsen i form af en software-as-a-service, herunder drift, support og vedligeholdelse. c) Bestillingsydelser: Leverandøren skal på Bygningsstyrelsens anmodning levere Bestillingsydelser til Løsningen, herunder f.eks. konsulentbistand til rådgivning, undervisning, konfiguration og etablering af integrationer til Bygningsstyrelsens øvrige it-systemer, som timebaserede ydelser. d) Ophørsydelser: Leverandøren skal ved hel eller delvis ophør af Kontrakten, uanset årsagen hertil, bistå Bygningsstyrelsen, i det omfang det er relevant og nødvendigt i forbindelse med transition af al data til Bygningsstyrelsen, andre leverandører eller myndigheder.

title: Germany – Construction work – Neubau Kita Schwalbennest - Elektroarbeiten
description: Die Gemeinde Schönefeld beabsichtigt die Kita Schwalbennest, Schwalbenweg 8, Schönefeld komplett neu zu errichten. Hier handelt es sich um die Elektroarbeiten. Im Zuge des Neubaus der KITA Schwalbennest wird die Elektroinstallation mit den Kostengruppen 440 und 450 ausgeschrieben. Die elektrische Energieversorgung erfolgt über einem neuen Hausanschluss der E.DIS Netz GmbH. Der Eektroenergiebedarf wird über eine Wandlermessung erfasst. Der neu zu errichtende Gebäude-Hauptverteiler(NSHV) versorgt dabei in dem zweigeschossigen Gebäude jeweils zwei Unterverteilungen pro Etage. Zur Senkung des Elektroenergiebedarfs ist eine PV-Anlage auf dem Flachdach vorgesehen. Im Gebäude ist eine Sicherheitsbeleuchtung der Flucht- und Rettungswege gemäß Brandschutzkonzept vorzusehen. Die Sicherheitsbeleuchtungsanlage wird gemäß DIN VDE 0108-100 und DIN EN 1838 ausgeführt. Die Sicherheitsbeleuchtung wird dabei über eine Einzellbatterieanlage realisiert. Die Erdungsanlage wird gemäß DIN 18014 hergestellt. Eine baurechtlich geforderte Blitzschutzanlage wird gemäß der Blitzschutzklasse III nach DIN VDE 0185-305 errichtet.

title: Germany – Training seminars – Seminare Kommunikation und Konflikte
description: Die Beschäftigten der BGHM stehen sowohl im internen Austausch mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen sowie Führungskräften als auch im Kontakt mit externen Personengruppen, beispielsweise Versicherten, Mitgliedsunternehmen, Leistungserbringenden und weiteren Verfahrensbeteiligten. Ziel der Maßnahmen ist es, die Handlungssicherheit der teilnehmenden Personen in unterschiedlichen Gesprächs- und Konfliktsituationen zu stärken und einen professionellen, wertschätzenden und lösungsorientierten Umgang mit herausfordernden Kommunikationssituationen zu fördern. Die Seminare sollen die Teilnehmer und Teilnehmerinnen dabei unterstützen, ihre kommunikativen Kompetenzen für die vielfältigen Anforderungen ihres beruflichen Alltags weiterzuentwickeln. Beide Seminare sollen unabhängig voneinander besucht werden können. Ziel des Vergabeverfahrens ist es, jeweils pro Los einen Rahmenvertrag mit einer/einem Trainer/in für die Konzeption und Durchführung von Seminaren zu den Themen "Gesprächsführung" (Los 1) sowie "Konfliktmanagement mit Schwerpunkt Deeskalation" (Los 2) abzuschließen.

title: Germany – Architectural, engineering and planning services – Straßen- und Kanalplanungen im Quartier Obere/Untere Schanze
description: Die Stadt Detmold beabsichtigt im Quartier Schanze die Straßen sowie die Schmutz- und Regenwasser-kanalisation zu sanieren/neu zu planen. Ziel ist die Sicherstellung der hydraulischen Leistungsfähigkeit, die bauliche Substanzkalkulation sowie die koordinierte Erschließung neuer Gebiete unter Berücksichtigung der parallel verlaufenden Straßen- und Fernwärmebaumaßnahmen. LOS 1 Objektplanung Verkehrsanlagen und Ingenieurbauwerke Der Planungsauftrag umfasst zum einen die bauliche und hydraulische Sanierung der Regen- und Schmutzwasserkanäle in den Straßen Untere Schanze, Obere Schanze, Amselweg, Amselhöhe und Unter der Jugendherberge in Detmold Hiddesen, gemäß des Abwasserbeseitigungskonzept (ABK) der Stadt Detmold (Ordnungsnummer 01.05.01) und zum anderen die Neuplanung der Straßen. In Teilen ist keine geregelte Regenentwässerung vorhanden, weshalb hier die erstmalige Erschließung herzustellen ist. Im Rahmen der Kanalsanierung des Parkwegs wurde die hydraulische Berechnung und die Dimensionierung eines Teilnetzes durchgeführt. Die Ergebnisse der Dimensionierung werden zur Verfügung gestellt. Des Weiteren sind alle Bestandshaltungen und -schächte, welche nicht auf Grund der Hydraulik erneuert werden, baulich zu bewerten. Für bauliche Mängel sind Sanierungskonzepte zu erarbeiten und mit dem Auftraggeber abzustimmen und umzusetzen. Alle weiteren notwendigen Bewertungen, Berechnungen, Nachweise, Anzeigen und Anträge sind Bestandteil dieses Auftrags. LOS 2 Technische Ausrüstung Das Ziel der Lichtplanung ist eine normgerechte Beleuchtung der Außenanlage nach der DIN EN 13201-1/2 mit der Einhaltung der aktuellen Fassung des BNatSchG. Die Planung bezieht sich nur auf die Leuchte und das Tragsystem. Die Planung der elektrischen Leistung ist nicht Gegenstand des Angebotes. Die Schnittstelle ist die Anschlussklemme im Kabelübergangskasten. Weitere Details entnehmen Sie bitte den Vergabeunterlagen.

description: Die Sporthalle (Sportanlage) an der Benzstraße 1 besteht aus einer Sporthalle mit 630 m2 NF und einem separaten Gymnastikraum mit 110 m2 NF sowie den dazu gehörenden Umkleiden, Nebenräumen, Erschließungsflächen und Technikbereichen. Der abgängige Bestand hat ca. 1.200 m2 BGF. Direkt anliegend und in gemeinsamer Nutzung befindet sich der Sportplatz mit einer Fläche von 6.000 m2. Die Planung umfasst den Ersatzneubau der Sporthalle und eines separaten Gymnastikraums mit Umkleiden, Nebenräumen, Erschließungsflächen und Technikbereichen sowie außenliegenden Umkleiden und Toiletten für den angrenzenden Sportplatz. Es handelt sich um eine Neubau-Fläche von ca. 1.430 m2 BGF. Der Neubau soll ressourcenschonend hinsichtlich Konstruktion und Material ausgeführt werden, hohe energetische Standards erfüllen (Effizienzgebäudestufe 40) sowie mit einer PV-Anlage, Retentionsflächen und einem Gründach ausgestattet werden.
